assumptions: Base is committed money only: open invoices, monthly contracts, parts estimates already created, and quoted jobs. No new service calls or T&M, and no parts purchased for them.

Upside line (dashed): adds expected service/T&M/parts work at the last 13 weeks' actual average ($16,888/week invoiced, collected 24 days later) less the parts actually bought for that work over the same 13 weeks ($9,982/week incl. HST: supplier bills on non-project POs plus parts suppliers and card purchases). Net ~$6,900/week. Both halves measured from QuickBooks.
Supplier bills are paid on their QuickBooks due dates.
Operating cash = RBC Income + Alpine Profit. Tax accounts and owner allocations are shown separately and not counted.

Core burn $25,400/week = actual QuickBooks costs, Jul–Sep average: field labour $62.4K/mo, office payroll $13.1K, fixed overhead $13.9K, vehicles $7.2K, shop/truck supplies $5.3K, loan payments $2.8K, other $5.3K. The floor and target are based on this.

Also paid out every week but not in the floor: discretionary spending $3,800/week (marketing, travel, training, meals) and owner draws $2,300/week (dividends $6,150/month plus owner building materials $3,806/month, Jul–Sep average).
Credit cards paid in full Oct 15. CRA source deductions ($20.0K) Oct 15, WSIB ($5.0K) Oct 30.

HST filed quarterly: $38.0K due Oct 31, paid from the HST account; only the $9.0K shortfall comes from operating cash. HST collected Oct–Dec is due Jan 31, after this window, and is included in the cash shown.
Open invoices collected at each customer's actual average days-to-pay (531 payments, 12 months; company average 24 days). Invoices already past that are spread evenly over weeks 1–3.
Finer Space and Blanchard contracts ($61.2K/month) billed on the 1st, collected in 20–22 days.

Jobs: quoted amounts from BuildOps; billed-to-date from QuickBooks invoices matched by the PO number in the invoice memo (quoted amounts include HST). Remaining billings follow thirds (1/3 start, 1/3 equipment delivery, 1/3 completion) where nothing is billed yet; partly billed jobs bill the rest at completion. QuickBooks is the source of truth for billing progress; BuildOps visits and budgeted hours set timing. Collected at each customer's usual days-to-pay.

notes: Percent complete = costs incurred (BuildOps labour actuals + QuickBooks bills by PO) ÷ BuildOps estimated cost, capped at 100%. Revenue is recognised as work is done, not when billed.
Field labour is a fixed weekly cost; job and service contribution = revenue minus materials and subcontractors.
Past weeks are QuickBooks monthly P&L (as billed) spread evenly by day, with owner building materials and non-recoverable COGS removed.
Projection assumes jobs finish on the schedule shown under Jobs, contracts continue, and service/T&M runs at the last 13 weeks' actual average. All amounts before HST.
NPSC ERV and NPSC Dehum/Hum are measured as one job because they ran together at the same site and costs may sit on either PO.
Non-labour actual costs come from QuickBooks only (bills and card purchases by PO). BuildOps job costing is used for labour hours only, so nothing is counted twice.
